_comment: Run modes a company picks in its first day, challenge runs, co-op campaign chapters and world presets. World preset is chosen by adding { "progression": { "worldPreset": "<id>" } } to config/rules.json before a world starts.

challenges.name: Lone Hull
challenges.text: Never own more than one ship.

challenges.name: No Upgrades
challenges.text: Never own a bulker (no hull upgrades).

campaign.name: Chapter 5: The Great Venture
campaign.text: As a crew, earn 100,000 credits of trip profit.

presets.name: Offline single-player
presets.text: Run the server on your own computer with bots as rivals: HOST=127.0.0.1 BOTS=12 TICK_MS=60000 npm run dev, then open http://127.0.0.1:8080. Nothing leaves your machine.

presets.name: Cosy seas
presets.text: No pirates. Set pirates.enabled to false in config/rules.json for this world.

presets.name: Pirate waters
presets.text: Raiding-focused world: pirates on, higher pirate bot share, home-port-only pirate ships off.

presets.name: Tycoon sandbox
presets.text: Every company plays with very large funds (needs the progression.sandbox economy switch).

presets.name: Steamship era
presets.text: Sepia palette and period names for ships and goods.

presets.name: Arctic map
presets.text: Icy palette. Fixed map config/maps/arctic.json: load it into a fresh world with server/scripts/use-map.ts.

presets.name: Mediterranean map
presets.text: Warm palette. Fixed map config/maps/mediterranean.json: load it into a fresh world with server/scripts/use-map.ts.
